elements.name: Inspect custom panel targets from a part document

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
ribbon customization is open on the Ribbon tab with Part | Tools selected
the Part | Tools custom panel list is empty
the user opens the target tab selector
the visible part targets include Tools, Manage, View, Environments, Collaborate and the final available command tab
they also include 3D Sketch, Construction, Edit Base Solid, Repair, Route, Render, Analysis, 3D Print, Freeform, Hidden Tab and BIM Content
the visible assembly targets include Mold Layout, Core/Cavity, Mold Assembly and Assemble
Part | Tools remains the selected target
the user closes the selector with Escape
the selector closes without changing the target or custom panel list
the user closes customization without making changes
the dialog closes and the part remains active
